sentences.text: It depends on whether the product note is the UCB’s approved policy: for cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB, and this residual clause applies here for the non_individual Tier 3 borrower. (core=true)
The documents do not state whether the 2% foreclosure charge in the product note is the UCB’s approved policy. (core=true)

The specific no-charge rules in paragraph 261(1) and 261(2) are stated for loans to individuals, and paragraph 261(2)(ii) is for loans to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises, so they do not cover a non_individual borrower. (core=true)

missing.searched: whether the product note is the UCB’s approved policy under paragraph 261(5)
